name: Archive Keeper
method: Direct visual inspection of all four views; alpha/framing pass does not imply anatomical consistency.
confirmed: Tall slender ice-blue crystal and silver articulated construct preserved.
Rear slate backing and segmented spine differentiated from luminous front display.
Profiles face opposite directions with cyan display on forward edge and toes forward.
limitations: Profile head backing is deeper than front suggests; establish fixed slate thickness.
Side chest/hip armor retains oblique exposure; camera alignment needs refinement.
Five fingers per hand not individually traceable due overlapping digits.
Rear hands and knee plates need explicit joint-axis and palm/back construction.
Front/back/left crest margins very tight despite no alpha edge failure.
Far limbs missing behind near limbs need complete hidden-part drawings for animation.
Crystal plate boundaries and highlights vary between views.
next: Resolve head cross-section, hands and joints, normalize framing, draw hidden limb parts, then animate precise core-handling and combat motions.
